mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification ( user_id, title, content, type, business_id, business_no, business_type, read_status, create_time, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{type}, #{businessId}, #{businessNo}, #{businessType}, #{readStatus}, #{createTime}, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM notification WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND read_status = 0 AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET read_status = 1, read_time = #{readTime}, update_time = #{readTime} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND read_status = 0 AND is_deleted = 0
